Your inspiration. Your space. Your command station. This is the driver-centric cabin within
the Mazda3 where every control is situated within your reach, so you can stay focused on the
road ahead. An intuitive instrument panel places gauges and displays within your line of sight
to minimize distraction. The center console and Commander control are positioned for optimal
comfort of the wrist and forearm. And the Mazda Connect™ Infotainment System includes
available Apple CarPlay™ integration for your iPhone® (shown) and Android Auto™ integration.1
Communication between you and your vehicle becomes second nature—by design.
1 Don’t drive while distracted or while using a hand-held device. See full disclaimer in Specifications.

To heighten your senses, we created a few of our own. Sophisticated safety innovations
that alert you to hazards and help you avoid collisions—or lessen their impact—is the
ingenious thinking behind i-Activsense.® This intelligent suite of available safety features1
such as Blind Spot Monitoring2 and Rear Cross Traffic Alert2 help improve your visibility
and awareness of the road.
1 i-Activsense® safety features are not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. There are limitations to the range and detection of each safety feature. Additional information provided in Specifications. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 2 Always check your mirrors.
Be aware of the traffic around you. There are limitations to the range and detection of the system. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details.
